Sources & methodology

Good information has a paper trail.

See what updates automatically, what is editorial, and when the underlying data was checked.

What this resource covers

San Jose Cannabis Delivery Planner is a focused consumer guide for adults in San Jose and the South Bay. The publication covers local culture and maintains practical reference tools.

Monthly data refresh

The refresh process checks primary references for the publication’s tools. The Terpene Explorer also fetches molecular formula and molecular weight from identified PubChem records. New data is validated before replacing the last successful values. An unavailable or unexpectedly changed source produces a review flag, not a fabricated update.

Brand histories, aroma descriptions and consumer guides are editorially reviewed separately. Their review dates do not change merely because a source was fetched. No live product stock, strain-specific terpene percentage, license certification or driver location is inferred.

How to interpret the tool

Brand comparison uses documented formats and geographic context. Aroma filtering uses clearly labeled sensory vocabulary. The lab converter calculates only from the values you enter. The receipt calculator uses only your entered amounts; it never calculates a legal tax determination or guarantees eligibility.

Further reading behind the field notes

  • Raw Garden: lab-result lookup ↗
  • Kiva: official portfolio ↗
  • PAX: products and support ↗
  • California Department of Cannabis Control: labeling resources ↗

Shareable results and editorial categories

The shortlist uses documented product formats in editorial order, with no paid ranking. Scent signatures use any-match aroma tags and reflect preferences only. Delivery cards record browser-entered assumptions. Downloaded cards are snapshots, and links reopen editable inputs using the currently published source data. Quiz answers and glossary entries are editorial learning material, reviewed with the guides.

Corrections

If a current official source differs from this guide, rely on that source for your decision. For an order or product question, contact the retailer directly. Source links make it possible to check the exact reference without relying on an unexplained score.
